issues.title: Text contrast is below 4.5:1 in the classic theme
Pagination and sheets bar buttons are smaller than 24 by 24px in the classic theme
Cell editor inputs have no accessible name
The accessible name of the Filters "Filter by value" component does not include its visible text
The Filters condition select and the autocomplete list use role=listbox without option children or a name
The Filters "Select all" and "Clear" controls are buttons nested inside buttons
The grid is built from divs with ARIA roles, and its treegrid root holds children the role does not allow
Text contrast is below 4.5:1 in the horizon theme
Menu items have no menu parent, and the highlighted item carries aria-selected
Menu separators are exposed as menu items
